double_barreled.label: Possible double-barreled question
double_barreled.detail: This question may be asking about two things at once. Split it into two separate questions so you know which factor matters to respondents.

leading_wording.label: Leading wording detected
leading_wording.detail: Loaded adjectives nudge respondents toward a specific answer. Try a neutral framing that doesn't telegraph the desired response.

agree_disagree_bias.label: Acquiescence-bias phrasing
agree_disagree_bias.detail: Phrases like "Don't you agree…" prime agreement. Reword as a neutral question that asks the respondent for their actual view.

vague_intensifier.label: Vague intensifier
vague_intensifier.detail: Words like "very" or "really" mean different things to different respondents. A more specific anchor (frequency, time, money) makes answers comparable across people.

too_short.label: Prompt is very short
too_short.detail: Questions under 4 words often miss context. Add the specific behaviour, timeframe, or scope you're asking about.

unbalanced_scale.label: Likert scale is unbalanced
unbalanced_scale.detail: This scale length is unusual. 5- and 7-point scales are the validated defaults — unbalanced or non-standard scales bias responses.

config.aiClusterLabel: Recommended: AI-cluster open responses (first run free)
config.npsNote: NPS uses the validated 0–10 scale with fixed Detractor / Passive / Promoter buckets. Anchor wording is locked: 0 = "Not at all likely", 10 = "Extremely likely".

guardrails.doubleBarreledDetail: Splitting 'speed and reliability' into two questions usually produces cleaner data.
guardrails.leadingDetail: Loaded adjectives bias responses. Try a neutral framing.
guardrails.shortDetail: A question under 8 characters often confuses respondents.

likert.note: Anchors are paired across the scale. You can rephrase each label, but the count of positive and negative options always stays equal — unbalanced scales bias responses toward the majority side.

nps.note: NPS uses the validated 0–10 scale with fixed Detractor (0–6) / Passive (7–8) / Promoter (9–10) buckets. Anchor wording is locked: 0 = "Not at all likely", 10 = "Extremely likely".

openText.note: Open text responses are AI-clustered into themes in the dashboard — a max length under 500 characters keeps clustering quality high.
